Delays are possible through the work zone.

From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. Monday through Thursday nights, Nov. 2-5, and again from Sunday night, Nov. 8, through Thursday night, Nov. 12, the eastbound I-90 on-ramp from East Mercer Way will close for bridge work.

Signed detours will be available.

Both directions of State Route 161 in Federal Way and Milton will reduce to one lane from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly between South 370th Street and Military Road South starting Monday, Oct. 26. 

At least one lane of SR 161 in each direction will remain open through this area each night. Construction is expected to occur Monday through Thursday nights until Friday morning, Nov. 6.

From 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3 through Thursday, Nov. 5, the road will reduce to one lane between 36th Street East and Dechaux Road East. The lane reduction creates a work zone for Washington State Department of Transportation maintenance crews to prepare the roadway for winter weather. For more information, visit the project webpage.

From 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2, the northbound SR 167 express toll lane will close approaching Stewart Road for guardrail repairs. While the tolled lane will be closed for approximately 2 miles, the rest to the lane will still be tolled. Anyone using the tolled lane will be charged the toll they see when they enter the lane. Read the travel advisory.

Up to three lanes of southbound I-405 from Sunset Boulevard North (milepost 6) to Talbot Road 
South/SR 515 (milepost 3) will be closed overnight from 11 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, 
Oct. 30 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31.

The northbound I-405 off-ramp to SR 169 will be closed overnight from 11:30 p.m. – 6:30 a.m., starting 
the night of Friday, Oct. 30 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 31. A signed detour will be in place.

Up to two lanes of northbound I-405 from SR 167 (milepost 2) to SR 169 (milepost 4) will be closed 
overnight from 11 p.m. – 7 a.m., starting the night of Friday, Oct. 30 to the morning of Saturday, Oct. 
31.
From 9:30 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2 to 12:30 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, two left lanes of southbound Interstate 5 at South 188th Street (milepost 152) will close for maintenance.

From 9 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, one left lane or two right lanes of northbound State Route 99 from East Marginal Way to South Atlantic Street (mileposts 27-30) will close for maintenance.

Northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, from I-90 to Northeast 45th Street. Adjacent ramps and lanes along this stretch of northbound I-5 are closed. The express lanes will operate northbound only through the weekend-long full closure.
The express lanes are northbound-only 24 hours a day until Monday, Nov. 2, at 5 a.m. due to lane reductions for construction on the northbound I-5 Ship Canal Bridge.
On I-5 northbound from I-90 (MP 164) to NE 45th St (MP 169), all lanes are closed.for roadwork until 5 a.m. Monday, 11/2/2026.

From 10 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6 to 6 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 7, all lanes of eastbound Interstate 90 from Rainier Avenue South (milepost 3) to North Mercer Way (milepost 6) will close for maintenance. The eastbound I-90 on-ramps from Interstate 5 and Rainier Avenue South will also close. Lanes begin closing at 8:30 p.m.

Friday, Nov. 13, until the morning of Monday, Nov. 16 - Westbound SR 520 between Montlake Boulevard and I-5 in Seattle will close for construction beginning at 11 p.m. Friday until 5 a.m. Monday. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic crossing Lake Washington will exit at Montlake or Lake Washington boulevards. Those who need access to I-5 from westbound SR 520 will need to use alternate routes. Eastbound SR 520 and the SR 520 Trail are not affected by this work and will remain open.
The Mercer Street on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The South Dearborn Street on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.

Monday, Oct. 26, on most weeknights until Friday, Nov. 13 - The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to both northbound I-5 and East Roanoke Street will close for construction on most weeknights beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. The typical closure dates are Monday through Thursday evenings, though some nights could be canceled based on needs and/or holidays. During this time, all westbound SR 520 traffic that remains on the bridge past Montlake and Lake Washington boulevards will detour to southbound I-5.
The westbound SR 520 off-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The Harvard Avenue East on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.

Saturday, Nov. 7, nightly until the morning of Monday, Nov. 9 - The eastbound SR 520 off-ramp to Montlake Boulevard in Seattle will close for construction nightly beginning at 10 p.m. until 6 a.m. During this time, all traffic from I-5 that enters eastbound SR 520 will pay the SR 520 bridge toll. Those who do not want to pay the toll or who need access to Montlake from I-5 must use alternate routes.
The westbound I-90 off-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The University Street on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The Cherry Street on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The northeast 130th Street on-ramp to southbound I-5 will close from 5 a.m. Sunday, Oct. 25, through 6 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, for utility work.
The Olive Way on-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.
The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to northbound I-5 is closed until 5 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, for construction.

The right lane of westbound SR 523/Northeast 145th Street will close from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. daily Monday, Oct. 26, through Friday, Nov. 13, from Interlaken Boulevard to Linden Avenue North for utility work.

From 11 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4 to Thursday, Nov. 5, three right lanes of northbound Interstate 5 from North 85th Street to Northeast 130th Street (milepost 171-173) will close for SDOT utilities work. The northbound I-5 on-ramp from westbound Northeast Northgate Way will also close.

From 11 p.m. Monday, Nov. 2 to 4 a.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3, three right lanes of southbound Interstate 5 from Northeast 155th Street to Northeast 117th Street (mileposts 175-173) will close for SDOT utilities work. From 11 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 3 to 4 a.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4, three left lanes will close.

Beginning Sept. 24, 2021 until further notice: The southbound Interstate 5 Silver Lake Rest Area is closed for maintenance indefinitely. There is no access for recreational vehicle dumping at this location.
From 9 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4 to 1 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, the right lane of westbound State Route 526 at Evergreen Way (milepost 3) will close for maintenance.

From 10 p.m. Wednesday, Nov. 4 to 4 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 5, one right lane of northbound Interstate 5 from the Union Slough bridge to the State Route 529 Steamboat Slough bridge (milepost 197-198) will close for maintenance.

Beginning Monday, Sept. 21 until 5 a.m. Friday, Oct. 9: Nightly from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. (except Saturdays), State Route 203 traffic will alternate with flaggers from US 2 to Main Street (milepost 24) for utilities.

From 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings crews will alternate traffic with flaggers and pilot cars in sections between a nearly 11-mile stretch of SR 203, just south of Duvall to the Monroe city limits (mileposts 12.53 to 23.20).

Nightly, from 9 p.m. until 7 a.m. Sunday nights through Friday mornings, contractor crews will alternate traffic through the intersections of State Route 525 in Mukilteo between Paine Field and the Mukilteo Ferry Terminal for pedestrian upgrades. Pedestrians may need to use local roads to detour around the work zone.
Until 2 p.m. Friday, Nov. 6: Eastbound and westbound State Route 96 will alternate from 6 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily near Lark Dairy Farm (milepost 6) for utility work.
Lowell-Snohomish River Road will alternate traffic near SR 9 beginning Wednesday, Sept. 30.
